requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: LED（D13）闪烁频率由 A0 控制（0.2~2 秒）
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_1 to an ADC value corresponding to a blink period of 0.2 s, then observe io_0 over time
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_0 toggles with blink period within [0.2 s, 0.2 s] (i.e., matches the minimum-period mapping)

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Set io_1 to an ADC value corresponding to a blink period of 2.0 s, then observe io_0 over time
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_0 toggles with blink period within [2.0 s, 2.0 s] (i.e., matches the maximum-period mapping)

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: LED（D13）闪烁频率由 A0 控制（0.2~2 秒）
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Sweep io_1 across its range from low to high while observing io_0 toggle rate
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: As io_1 increases, the observed blink period moves monotonically within the constraint band 0.2 s to 2.0 s
